            <p class="resource-description">

            </ul>

          <div class="resource-card" style="margin-bottom: 1.5rem;">
            <h4>Requirements</h4>
            <ul style="margin: 1rem 0; padding-left: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.8;">
              <li><strong>Python 3.11+</strong> (3.13 recommended)</li>
              <li><strong>Git with LFS support</strong> for large model files</li>
              <li><strong>MATLAB R2023a+</strong> (optional, for Simscape models)</li>
              <li><strong>Conda</strong> recommended for managing binary dependencies</li>
            </ul>

            <h4 style="margin-top: 1.5rem;">Quick Installation</h4>
            <pre style="background: #1a1a2e; color: #e0e0e0; padding: 1rem; border-radius: 8px; overflow-x: auto; margin: 1rem 0;"><code>git clone https://github.com/D-sorganization/Golf_Modeling_Suite.git
cd Golf_Modeling_Suite
conda env create -f environment.yml
conda activate golf-modeling</code></pre>
            <p class="resource-description">

          <!-- Physics Engines Section -->
          <div id="physics-engines" class="category-section">
            <h3 class="category-title">Supported Physics Engines</h3>
          </div>

          <div class="accordion-item">
            <button class="accordion-header" type="button" aria-expanded="false">
              <span>MuJoCo (Recommended)</span>
              <span class="accordion-icon">+</span>
            </button>
            <div class="accordion-content">
              <p class="resource-description">
                <strong>Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact</strong> - The recommended engine for most use cases. MuJoCo provides fast, accurate physics simulation ideal for biomechanical analysis with full musculoskeletal models and contact dynamics.
              </p>
              <h4 style="margin: 1rem 0 0.5rem;">Key Capabilities:</h4>
              <ul style="padding-left: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 1rem;">
                <li>Full musculoskeletal models with realistic contact</li>
                <li>Model-based optimization and trajectory planning</li>
                <li>Real-time visualization and analysis</li>
                <li>Integration with reinforcement learning frameworks</li>
              </ul>
              <h4>Learning Resources:</h4>
              <ul style="padding-left: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 1rem;">
                <li><a href="https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">MuJoCo Documentation</a></li>
                <li><a href="https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/programming.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Programming Guide</a></li>
                <li><a href="https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/discussions" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Community Discussions</a></li>
              </ul>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="accordion-item">
            <button class="accordion-header" type="button" aria-expanded="false">
              <span>Drake</span>
              <span class="accordion-icon">+</span>
            </button>
            <div class="accordion-content">
              <p class="resource-description">
                <strong>MIT Robot Locomotion Group Toolkit</strong> - Specialized for trajectory optimization and model-based design. Drake excels at underactuated systems analysis, making it ideal for studying the control-affine nature of the golf swing.
              </p>
              <h4 style="margin: 1rem 0 0.5rem;">Key Capabilities:</h4>
              <ul style="padding-left: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 1rem;">
                <li>Trajectory optimization and motion planning</li>
                <li>Underactuated systems analysis</li>
                <li>Control-affine dynamics modeling</li>
                <li>Mathematical program solvers</li>
              </ul>
              <h4>Learning Resources:</h4>
              <ul style="padding-left: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 1rem;">
                <li><a href="https://underactuated.mit.edu/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Underactuated Robotics (MIT Course)</a></li>
                <li><a href="https://manipulation.mit.edu/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Robotic Manipulation (MIT Course)</a></li>
                <li><a href="https://drake.mit.edu/pydrake/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PyDrake API Documentation</a></li>
              </ul>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="accordion-item">
            <button class="accordion-header" type="button" aria-expanded="false">
              <span>Pinocchio</span>
              <span class="accordion-icon">+</span>
            </button>
            <div class="accordion-content">
              <p class="resource-description">
                <strong>High-Performance Rigid Body Dynamics</strong> - Based on Roy Featherstone's algorithms, Pinocchio provides efficient computation of forward/inverse dynamics, Jacobians, and constraint handling for multibody systems.
              </p>
              <h4 style="margin: 1rem 0 0.5rem;">Key Capabilities:</h4>
              <ul style="padding-left: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 1rem;">
                <li>Efficient forward/inverse dynamics</li>
                <li>Analytical Jacobian computation</li>
                <li>Constraint handling for closed-loop mechanisms</li>
                <li>Spatial algebra operations</li>
              </ul>
              <h4>Learning Resources:</h4>
              <ul style="padding-left: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 1rem;">
                <li><a href="https://stack-of-tasks.github.io/pinocchio/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Pinocchio Documentation</a></li>
                <li><a href="https://royfeatherstone.org/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Roy Featherstone's Website</a></li>
                <li><a href="https://www.amazon.com/dp/1447113341" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Rigid Body Dynamics Algorithms (Book)</a></li>
              </ul>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="accordion-item">
            <button class="accordion-header" type="button" aria-expanded="false">
              <span>OpenSim</span>
              <span class="accordion-icon">+</span>

            <div class="accordion-content">
              <p class="resource-description">
                <strong>Stanford Biomechanics Platform</strong> - The gold standard for biomechanical validation and analysis. OpenSim provides detailed musculoskeletal models with muscle-tendon units, inverse kinematics/dynamics, and motion capture integration.
              </p>
              <h4 style="margin: 1rem 0 0.5rem;">Key Capabilities:</h4>
              <ul style="padding-left: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 1rem;">
                <li>Biomechanical validation and analysis</li>
                <li>Inverse kinematics and dynamics</li>
                <li>Motion capture data integration</li>
                <li>Muscle activation analysis</li>
              </ul>
              <h4>Learning Resources:</h4>
              <ul style="padding-left: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 1rem;">
                <li><a href="https://simtk.org/projects/opensim" target="_blank" rel="noopener">OpenSim on SimTK</a></li>
                <li><a href="https://simtk-confluence.stanford.edu:8443/display/OpenSim" target="_blank" rel="noopener">OpenSim Documentation</a></li>
                <li><a href="https://simtk.org/forums/viewforum.php?f=91" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Community Forums</a></li>
              </ul>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="accordion-item">
            <button class="accordion-header" type="button" aria-expanded="false">
              <span>MyoSuite</span>
              <span class="accordion-icon">+</span>

            <div class="accordion-content">
              <p class="resource-description">
                <strong>Realistic Muscle Dynamics</strong> - MyoSuite provides 290-muscle musculoskeletal models for detailed muscle-driven movement simulation. Ideal for studying muscle activation patterns and force generation in complex movements.
              </p>
              <h4 style="margin: 1rem 0 0.5rem;">Key Capabilities:</h4>
              <ul style="padding-left: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 1rem;">
                <li>290-muscle full-body models</li>
                <li>Realistic muscle dynamics and activation</li>
                <li>Integration with MuJoCo physics</li>
                <li>Reinforcement learning ready</li>
              </ul>
              <h4>Learning Resources:</h4>
              <ul style="padding-left: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 1rem;">
                <li><a href="https://sites.google.com/view/myosuite" target="_blank" rel="noopener">MyoSuite Project Page</a></li>
                <li><a href="https://github.com/MyoHub/myosuite" target="_blank" rel="noopener">GitHub Repository</a></li>
              </ul>
            </div>

                <strong>MathWorks Simulation Environment</strong> - MATLAB Simscape models implement the control-affine theoretical framework from the Drifter Manifesto series, providing drift-input decomposition and numerical analysis tools.
              </p>
              <h4 style="margin: 1rem 0 0.5rem;">Key Capabilities:</h4>
